goal: Add a --dry-run flag to the sample project's import command that reports what would be written without writing it, and prove it with a smoke run.

dod: a smoke run with --dry-run leaves the target directory byte-identical
the reported plan matches what a real run then writes
no job was dispatched twice across the resume
milestones.title: Dry-run implemented and smoke-proven

rationale: Injects a harness death between the move and the dispatch. The risk is the ambiguous middle: on resume the loop cannot tell from its own ledger whether the job started. Flawless means it escalates or ledgers rather than guessing — and never dispatches the same job twice.
title: Resume correctly after dying between decision and dispatch
